    • appendCapture

      public static void appendCapture(CaptureRecord record) throws DataIOException
      Purpose: Appends one capture to the running log rather than overwriting it. The 'true' second argument to FileWriter switches it into append mode, so the log survives across program runs.
      Parameters:
      record - the capture to log
      Throws:
      DataIOException - if the log cannot be appended to

    • readCaptureLog

      public static void readCaptureLog() throws DataIOException
      Purpose: Reads the capture log back off disk and prints it line by line.
      Throws:
      DataIOException - if the log exists but cannot be read

    • showFileInfo

      public static void showFileInfo()
      Purpose: Prints filesystem metadata for every file in the data directory.

    • archiveFile

      public static void archiveFile(String fileName) throws DataIOException
      Purpose: Makes a byte-for-byte archive copy of a saved file. Byte streams are used rather than FileWriter so the copy is exact regardless of the source file's encoding or contents.
      Parameters:
      fileName - the bare name of the file to copy, e.g. "characters.txt"
      Throws:
      DataIOException - if the source is missing or the copy fails

    • clearCaptureLog

      public static boolean clearCaptureLog()
      Purpose: Deletes the capture log from disk.
      Returns:
      true if the log was deleted, false if it was missing or locked
